Temivu Showcase script font subsets

ja.otf and zh.otf derive from Noto Sans CJK JP and SC Regular, version 2.004.
Copyright 2014–2021 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/).
Source project https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk
License OFL-CJK.txt

ar.ttf derives from Noto Sans Arabic Regular, version 2.005.
Copyright 2015–2020 Google LLC. All Rights Reserved.
Source project https://github.com/notofonts/arabic
License OFL-Arabic.txt

The source fonts were obtained from the system fonts-noto-cjk and
fonts-noto-core packages. Temivu subsets the three fonts with FontTools 4.61.1
using the characters in the corresponding Messages entry in
src/generated_localizations.rs and the preview's native language name.
The subsets keep the layout features and use distinct family names
Temivu Showcase JA, Temivu Showcase ZH, and Temivu Showcase AR.
